title: There's Still Plenty Of Action For The GOP To Take On Sharia law In Texas - NewsBreak
text:
By Ethan Buchanan ,
12 hours ago Stopping the expansion of Sharia law in Texas has become one of the top priorities of the Republican Party base here in Texas. Bills claiming to address the issue have been passed by the legislature and signed into law in both 2017 and 2025.
Despite these bills, there’s still plenty of work that can be done to address Islamist expansion in the Lone Star State. Rep. Brian Harrison called specifically to defund the groups pushing it, saying: “We’ve got to stop funding organizations that have ties to radical terror organizations. We’ve got to do more to tighten up our grant review process.”
He called the fact that this hasn’t been done already an outrage and blamed the uniparty in Austin for failing to act. “The Austin establishment politicians have been telling everybody, dishonestly, for years that Texas has banned Sharia law. That’s one of the most important things that I have got to stress to people. It’s that no, Texas has not banned Sharia law,” he said.
Harrison also pointed out that what laws are passed are very often littered with loopholes and carveouts, something that he says also needs to be addressed. According to him: “Texans are shocked to learn that in the bill to supposedly ‘ban’ EPIC City, there was literally an exemption in that bill to exempt EPIC City.”
He’s now calling for these issues to be addressed now, in a special session, rather than waiting for the next regular session, which isn’t scheduled to start until the spring.
